verdict.rationale: Handelsregister / Unternehmensregister is Germany's statutory public company-register portal. It serves legally mandated public records, such as register entries, filings and announcements, from the German state registers. It is not a service where users host their own data, so a user-selectable storage region or residency option is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack shows any storage-location choice that would make the axis apply.
